common.notFound: The requested record was not found.
common.unreachable: The backend could not be reached.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested operational view does not exist.

setup.title: Set up the platform database
setup.intro: UDDP needs a PostgreSQL database. Enter its connection; the platform creates its schema and switches on without a restart.
setup.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
setup.createDatabase: Create the database if it does not exist
setup.applying: Applying settings and creating the schema…
setup.problem: The saved settings could not be used: {{problem}}
setup.storedHint: The password is stored encrypted on this machine and is never shown again.
setup.adminIntro: The database is ready. Choose the username and password of the platform administrator; this account then creates the other users.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: The platform database connection and the demo reset.
settings.environmentLocked: Environment variables are set, so the connection is managed outside the UI.
settings.runInProgress: An onboarding run is in progress; the connection cannot be changed now.
settings.resetIntro: Drops and recreates every UDDP object in {{database}} and removes the Studio's packs, drafts and uploads. Only databases whose name ends with _demo can be reset.
settings.resetNotAllowed: The configured database does not end with _demo, so it cannot be reset from the UI.
settings.resetConfirm: Type the database name to confirm
settings.resetDone: The demo database is empty again; the Studio has no sources.

studio.title: Onboarding Studio
studio.description: Onboard a department's source from its files: upload, map, crosswalk, rules, preview, publish and onboard — no platform code per source.
studio.noStates: No sources yet. Start with “New source”.
studio.demoModeOff: The backend is not loading packs from the Studio packs directory ({{directory}}); publishing is disabled. Start it with scripts/run-demo.ps1.

upload.largeWorkbook: This workbook is {{size}} MB. Large workbooks are read whole when they are shaped; for a faster, lighter load export the sheets as CSV.
upload.sheetsHint: Tick the sheets this source reads. All sheets are loaded until you untick some.
upload.sampled: Profiled from a sample: {{sampled}} of {{total}} rows
upload.connectionSaved: Connection {{name}} saved; the password is stored encrypted on this machine.
upload.changeColumnHint: A column that grows on every change, such as updated_at or an increasing id. Each delivery then reads only rows changed since the last one.

map.intro: Suggestions are pre-filled with their confidence. A column with no target is kept on the Resident as an extension.
map.recordKeyHint: Needed when the record ID is shared by several rows (e.g. a household number)
map.layoutProposalsIntro: Patterns found in the uploaded file. Nothing is applied until you accept it.

crosswalk.intro: Each coded column's values are crosswalked onto platform codes. Suggestions are pre-filled; choose a code for every blank row.
crosswalk.none: No coded columns need a crosswalk.
crosswalk.missing: {{count}} value(s) still need a platform code.

rules.intro: Platform defaults are pre-filled. Matching thresholds must be the same for every source, because one matching run compares residents across all sources.

preview.intro: A dry run of the first {{rows}} rows through the existing mapping and validation engines. Nothing is written.
preview.blocked: Publishing is blocked until the blocking errors are fixed.
preview.packError: The configuration is not a valid Source Pack yet: {{message}}
preview.name: Name

publish.intro: The Source Pack files the Studio will write, in the standard format. They are read-only here.
publish.published: Published version {{version}}: approved, registered and ACTIVE.
publish.blocked: Fix the blocking preview errors before submitting.
publish.pending: Submitted: waiting for a different user with approval rights to approve or reject this version.

delivery.title: Upload new delivery
delivery.intro: Replaces this source's file with a new delivery; the next onboarding run reports new, changed, unchanged and removed rows.
delivery.choose: Choose the new delivery file first.
delivery.failed: Unable to upload the new delivery
delivery.done: New delivery uploaded. Start onboarding to process it.

progress.title: Mapping progress
progress.changes: Compared with the previous delivery: {{new}} new · {{changed}} changed · {{unchanged}} unchanged · {{removed}} removed
progress.legend: File rows include title, header and total rows. New or changed: records stored as a new version. Skipped: records unchanged since the previous delivery, plus the title, header and total rows the layout steps remove. Rejected: rows that could not be mapped, with their reason in the CSV.

counts.MAPPED: {{in}} file rows · {{out}} new or changed records

landing.title: Landing folder
landing.intro: Large deliveries are copied into this source's landing folder ({{location}}) instead of uploaded.
landing.started: Run started; follow it in the timeline below.

onboard.intro: Runs ingestion (generic Hop template), mapping, data quality, matching (Splink) and the Golden build for this source.
onboard.paused: Paused before the Golden build: this delivery needs a person to release it. A platform admin or data steward approves the release on the run page.

done.title: {{state}} is onboarded
done.intro: No platform code was written for this source. Explore the results:

portability.title: Portability evidence
portability.description: What each source needed: generated configuration only. Platform code changes are computed from git, never asserted.
portability.changedSinceBaseline: Platform files this build changes compared with {{ref}} (the platform itself, shared by every source)
portability.guardMissing: No guard report yet (run mvn test).

approval.title: Pending approvals
approval.description: Source Pack versions and stewardship decisions submitted by one user and waiting for a second user to approve or reject them.
approval.awaiting: You submitted this version; a different user must approve or reject it.

shape.title: Shape (clean-up)
shape.intro: Messy files (title rows, ditto marks, differently spelt columns, a name and relation in one cell) are tidied by layout steps and parsers. Switch on what applies; nothing is changed in the file, and the steps are saved in the source's layout: and parse: only.
shape.none: Nothing to clean up was found in this file. You can still add an alias or a field parser below.
shape.parserIntro: Run a built-in parser (Tier 2) or a loaded plug-in (Tier 3) over one column, for example mobile-number@1.0 on a column of mixed phone formats. The parser is tried on the first filled sample value to learn its outputs; each output becomes a new column that the Map step offers. The original column is kept.
shape.parserPrefixHint: Each output becomes <name>_<output>, for example contact_numbers_mobile and contact_numbers_other_mobiles.
shape.parserNoSample: Column {{column}} has no filled value in the sample rows, so the parser's outputs cannot be learnt.
shape.parserNoOutput: {{parser}} returned nothing for the first sample value of {{column}}. Test it on Shaping plug-ins, or pick another column.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: A searchable, append-only record of security and operational activity.
audit.empty: No audit events match these filters.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
auth.ssoDenied: Single sign-on worked, but your account has no UDDP role or state. Ask an administrator.
auth.ssoFailed: Single sign-on did not complete. Try again or sign in with your username.
auth.changeRequired: You must choose a new password before you continue.
auth.policy: At least 12 characters with upper- and lower-case letters, a digit and a symbol; not your username.

stewardship.title: Stewardship
stewardship.description: Review queue and manual merge/split. Every action is submitted for approval by a second user.
stewardship.submitted: Submitted for approval; nothing changes until a different user approves it.

fix.MAPPING: Fix in pack: Map columns step

preview.title: Held and rejected rows in this sample
preview.none: No row in the sample would be held.

bulk.title: Pending bulk rejects
bulk.none: No bulk rejects are waiting for a second steward.
bulk.caption: Bulk rejects waiting for a second steward
bulk.own: You requested this; another steward must decide

types.HELD_BULK_PENDING: Bulk rejects waiting for a second steward

users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in, with which roles, for which states. Every change is audited.
users.oneTimeHint: It is shown only now. Give it to the user privately; they must change it at first sign-in.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Which role grants which permission. Roles are defined by the platform and read-only here.

canonicalDetail.title: Canonical record
canonicalDetail.description: One source record as the platform understood it, with its lineage.

matchingRun.title: Matching run
matchingRun.description: Who the model decided is the same person, and why.

benefitDetail.title: Benefit
benefitDetail.description: One benefit with its beneficiaries, household, disbursements and source observations.
benefitDetail.name: Name

queue.title: Waiting for approval
queue.ownChange: You proposed this; another user must decide it.

words.title: Word lists
words.description: The lists the shaping parsers read: relation markers, deceased markers, honorifics, name variants, ditto tokens, address tokens and village aliases. A change is a proposal that a different user approves.
words.pending: A change to this list is waiting for approval.
words.proposed: Proposed; it is waiting for approval.
words.testIntro: Pick a built-in parser or a loaded Tier-3 plug-in, enter one value as it appears in a source file, and see what the parser returns. It runs exactly as a source's parse: step would, with the word lists as they are now. Nothing is saved.
words.testOptionsHint: The parser's own step keys, for example {"dayFirst": false}
words.testOptionsInvalid: Options must be a JSON object, for example {"dayFirst": false}.
words.outputs: Output keys (use them in a parse: step's outputs)
words.noOutput: The parser returned no values for this input.

plugins.title: Shaping plug-ins
plugins.description: Test any parser on a value, see the built-in operations and parsers, and approve the Tier-3 plug-in jars found when the platform started.
plugins.restart: An approval or revocation is written to approved-plugins.yaml and takes effect the next time the platform starts.
plugins.name: Name

geography.title: Geography master
geography.description: Load an LGD snapshot into the geography master: check the file first, then load it.
geography.forbidden: Only platform administrators can load the geography master.
geography.choose: Drop a .csv or .json file here, or choose one
geography.format: CSV columns: entityType, code, name, status, parentType, parentCode, effectiveFrom (optional first line: # asOf=YYYY-MM-DD).

diff.title: Changes against the active master
diff.none: No changes: the master already matches this file.

errors.some: {{count}} errors. Fix the file and check it again.
errors.many: At least {{count}} errors (only the first are listed). Fix the file and check it again.

geography.loadBlocked: Fix the errors above before loading.

confirm.title: Load {{name}}?
confirm.body: This adds and updates entities. It never deletes: anything missing from the file stays as it is.

run.failed: The load failed and the master is unchanged. {{error}}
run.unchanged: The file matches the master: nothing changed.

current.title: Current master
current.none: No snapshot has been loaded yet.
